Ford Bronco Custom Decals

This post is for you if you want to make your company/corporate vehicle more colourful or if you just want to boost the exposure of your brand. This article is on our client City of Toronto – Toronto Community Crisis Service and how they branded their crossover SUV, Ford Bronco.

Vehicle Branding for the City of Toronto

Toronto Community Crisis Service (TCCS) wanted to have the company logo on their business vehicle. Brand visibility is important to them for their community safety programs to be publicly known so that they can provide services that are centred around Indigenous philosophies of holistic health and wellness.

Following a consultation with our sales representatives and graphic design professionals, they decided on installing Kamaamwizme wii Naagidiwendiiying lettering which stands for coming together to heal/look after/take care of each other, the City of Toronto logo, and lastly Toronto Community Crisis Service (TCCS) logo.

Installation Process

Our specialists agreed that the vinyl materials from Avery Dennison in green and black were the best choices for this project. After that, our installers, who have more than 10 years of expertise in the wrapping business, started the process on the vehicle. Our quick turnaround limited the downtime on Toronto Community Crisis Service (TCCS)’s services since after 48 hours the car was back in business, ready to advertise with its creative design and increasing exposure to communities who need their safety program.

If you’d like to learn more about decals, letterings, and full wraps or simply want to make a little change with your car, we suggest chatting with our team. You can reach them at 416-746-1381 or email us at info@vinylwraptoronto.com.
